topology.description: Posterior touch enters a reduced A27h forward path; anterior touch enters an MDN-to-A18b backward path while Pair1 suppresses the forward path. Both paths converge on the same named motor identities and A1-A6 muscle fibers.

connections.evidence: Zarin et al. 2019, Nature Communications 10:2650; axial-locomotion literature audit

limitations: The named circuit evidence is primarily later-instar anatomy and physiology; it is not asserted as a complete L1 whole-body connectome.
Intersegmental edges, delays, currents, Pair1 persistence, and relaxation gains are fitted reduced-model parameters.
Forward and backward paths change neural timing; they do not select separate muscle identities.
T3, A7, and A8 remain outside the named-fiber force projection because the present attachment atlas covers A1-A6.

named_fiber_body_coupling.transverse_force_role: Contact-release drive only; T-group activation is excluded from segment axial shortening and axial node force.
named_fiber_body_coupling.force_projection_limitation: The reduced straight-crawl body executes only the axial component of mapped-fiber tension because individual L1 3D attachment vectors are not measured.

continuous_ground_contact.evidence_source: Booth et al. 2015, Journal of Neurophysiology 113:3322-3336

t3_backward_contact_proxy.limitation: This contact-only T3 transverse activation proxy closes the anterior boundary missing from the A1-A6 atlas. It is not a reconstructed L1 motor neuron or measured T3 muscle identity.

limitations: Contact retention is a continuous fitted proxy for attachment and release; it is not a measured friction coefficient.
The model consumes local transverse-fiber activation only and never receives requested or observed movement direction.
Forward and backward premotor paths use fitted, different transverse-fiber timing; this phase relation is a hypothesis, not a measured L1 delay.
Published L2 protopod normal forces are not transferred as L1 axial forces.

validation.calibration_partition: Greaney 2026 L1 calibration animals for forward kinematics only

directional_shape_gate.note: The backslip and shape thresholds are engineering rejection gates, not measured L1 constants.

selected_parameters: maximum shortening fractions within the declared body-model upper bound
rejected_candidates: Contact-weighted XPBD inverse mass: produced discontinuous segment jumps.
A1-A6 contact interpolation into unobserved head/tail regions: reduced stride.
Calibration-median nonuniform adjacent wave delays: matched local timing but failed stride, efficiency, and retrace gates.
fitting_record.selection_rule: Use calibration values and causal/shape gates together; do not use the six-animal diagnostic held-out values for selection.

required_gates: posterior touch yields posterior-to-anterior A27h order and anatomical-forward displacement
anterior touch yields MDN-to-A18b anterior-to-posterior order and anatomical-backward displacement
all active forces trace to a preceding sensory and neural event
forward calibration kinematics and distortion/backslip gates pass
Python and native C++ parity remains a future gate before mobile integration
validation.claim_limit: Bidirectional embodied neural research approximation; not independently validated L1 locomotion.
